# What each vendor folder is FOR, one line each: <path>  <status>  # reason
# Statuses: current (this design uses it), v1 (the built V1 kits only, not the V2 board set),
#           retired (superseded by a ruling; kept for the record), tooling (not a document).
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. A document store answers with whatever it holds, and this folder holds the
# whole history: the u-blox receiver that the Quectel ruling replaced, the Touch Display 2 that the
# Xenarc replaced, the DMR858M that was dropped from both kits. A retrieval that returns a retired
# part's page with the same standing as a current one does not merely waste a minute; it is the
# exact shape of the defect this repository has already paid for twice, a confident claim about a
# part nobody re-read (a TPS2065CDBV on a SOT-23-6 land for four board phases).
#
# So: kb_search.py LABELS every hit with the status of its folder and pushes a retired one down the
# ranking, and kb_verify.py FAILS when a vendor folder has no line here. A new folder cannot enter
# the store as "current" by default, and a retirement is a line with a ruling behind it rather than
# something a session is expected to remember.
#
# A file line overrides its folder line. Written 10 September 2026 (MESHSAT-862), each reason
# traceable to a ruling in the design record or to the generator that instantiates the part.

# --- retired by a ruling, kept for the record ---
aioc         retired   # the V1 audio-interface chain went with the PicoAPRS V4 ruling of 8 September 2026: no AIOC, no sound card, no PTT wiring
audio        retired   # WM8960 and CM108B were the D7-era codec path; the current D and P boards carry a PCM2912A, and the Direwolf guide went with the same PicoAPRS ruling
dmr858       retired   # the DMR858M was dropped from V2 on 6 September and from V1 on 8 September 2026; both modules went back unopened
gnss         retired   # the u-blox NEO-M9N, MAX-M10S and SAM-M10Q were replaced by the Quectel LG290P on 6 September 2026 (MESHSAT-823)
lte          retired   # the EG25-G mini PCIe path and its socket were replaced by an M.2 B-key 5G module on 6 September 2026; the SIMCom and T-Call sheets were evaluation reading
nicerf       current   # NOT retired despite the folder's history: its one file is the SA868 datasheet, and the SA868 is the ruled V2 radio (six generators reference it). The NiceRF part that was retired is the DMR858M, which lives in dmr858/
td2          retired   # the Touch Display 2 was replaced by the Xenarc 709GNK on 6 September 2026
weact        retired   # the WeAct 3.7 e-paper module was replaced by the PDi E2370KS0C1 on 6 September 2026; its drawing is still the mechanical reference for the window because the two share the glass
traco        retired   # the TEN 40-2412WIN is on no current BOM: E6 carries none of it, and the only mention left in a generator is a KiCad footprint name. The README had this right and my first status line did not
usb2517      retired   # the USB2517I is on no current BOM either: the only mention left in gen_sch_a.py is a historical note in its title block
wio          retired   # the Wio-SX1262 SPI LoRa module was replaced by the E22-900M30S class on 6 September 2026

tcall        v1        # T-Call A7670 models from the V1 kits
x1202        v1        # the Geekworm X1202 was removed from V2 on 4 September 2026 (appendix 32.17) and is still the V1 kits' charger (MESHSAT-793)
